name: 44572-solodecode-32bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), compute capability 9.0. THE CARD MUST BE IDLE: this is a single-stream latency measurement and it has no queue to hide interference behind.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, `uni` single-process executor, V1 engine core, one in-process vLLM engine. A 32 GB fp8 checkpoint fits one 80 GB card with room to spare.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, dense (no mixture of experts), 64 layers, hidden 5120, MLP intermediate 25600, 64 query / 8 key-value heads, head_dim 128, vocab 151936, max_position_embeddings 40960, ~32 GB of fp8 weights. Read off the cached checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, 4 warmup requests by count, bounded at 68 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, so 64 are scored. Exactly one sequence is resident -- the generator holds one stream and `max-num-seqs: 1` makes the engine agree -- and decode cudagraphs are on with a capture width of 1, so the declared width is the width that runs.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, FIXED 512 prompt tokens / 512 output tokens with no variance (min = max = nominal on both), `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied, `temperature: 0.0`, static seed 44572. Driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend with no HTTP hop; `max_tokens` and `ignore_eos=True` are set on every request, so all 512 output tokens are always produced and no request ends early. In `plain` mode the prompt is 512 tokens on the nose; any drift in the prompt-token count away from 512 is real drift to be investigated, not rounded away.
purpose: A single-user 32-billion-parameter writing assistant answering one 512-token prompt at a time with 512-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: commit 521b88c29ef29b37efefa64efda7b59ec99d210c (v0.22.1rc0-501-g521b88c29ef2).

# Already in this machine's HF cache (32 GB under $HF_HOME, 7 safetensors shards).
# No `quantization:` key here on purpose: the checkpoint declares its own method and passing a
# flag would override it.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-FP8

max-model-len: 4096

# LOAD-BEARING: prompts are independently sampled per request, so one request must never be
# answered from another's work.
enable-prefix-caching: false

max-num-batched-tokens: 2048

# One engine, no worker processes, which is also what the in-process backend needs.
distributed-executor-backend: uni

# LOAD-BEARING: the declared operating point is a single stream, and this ceiling makes that a
# property of the ENGINE and not only of the load generator.
max-num-seqs: 1

block-size: 16

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# `enforce-eager` is deliberately absent: decode cudagraphs stay on, as they would in a
# deployment. Turning eager mode on would be a different setup.
